### REVOLVE Unveils the Porsche Collection by REVOLVE


August 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/458606031/files/doc_news/REVOLVE-Unveils-the-Porsche-Collection-by-REVOLVE-2026.pdf)


Inspired by motorsport heritage, the exclusive collection fuses
Porsche's iconic racing legacy with REVOLVE's modern fashion perspective.


LOS ANGELES


, August 24, 2026


**/PRNewswire/ -- REVOLVE Group, Inc.** today debuts the **Porsche Collection by REVOLVE** , a 32-piece limited-edition capsule that celebrates the unmistakable spirit of one of the world's most iconic automotive brands.


Launching exclusively at **REVOLVE** on August 24, the capsule reimagines **Porsche** 's legendary motorsport heritage through a contemporary fashion lens, blending premium materials, modern silhouettes and everyday versatility. The inspiration behind the collection is anchored by the infamous **Porsche 959** , which is regarded as one of the most groundbreaking sports cars ever created. Designed for a new generation of enthusiasts, the capsule bridges the worlds of luxury fashion and automotive culture with pieces that move seamlessly from the street to the paddock.


Spanning more than 30 styles, the **Porsche Collection by REVOLVE** features a curated assortment of women's and men's ready-to-wear and accessories, including premium leather outerwear, suede separates, heritage-inspired jerseys, graphic tees, hoodies, knitwear, denim, sportswear and a selection of exclusive caps and silk scarves. Signature design elements draw from Porsche's racing archives, incorporating bold color blocking, motorsport graphics, racing typography and references to the iconic Porsche 959 throughout the collection.


"We see tremendous opportunity in partnering with legacy lifestyle brands that have built enduring cultural relevance. Porsche is a brand known for performance, innovative engineering and timeless design, and this collection brings that heritage into elevated, contemporary fashion inspired by motorsport. By bringing these iconic names into the fashion conversation, we continue to strengthen REVOLVE's position as the destination for thoughtfully curated collaborations that resonate with today's consumer." - **Raissa Gerona, President, Brand & Partnerships, REVOLVE** **Group Inc**


Creatively directed by **Sarah Bassett** , photographed by **Victor Braun** and styled by **Margherita Moro,** the accompanying campaign brings the collection's design philosophy to life. Highlights of the collection include the **959 Anniversary Leather Jacket, Rallye Jacket, La Corniche Suede Biker, Racing Mini Skirt** , heritage-inspired jerseys, premium knitwear and a selection of collectible accessories. Retail prices range from $60 to $1,400, with women's and men's apparel available in sizes XXS–XL, offering a mix of collectible statement pieces and everyday wardrobe staples.


Designed as a **REVOLVE** exclusive, the collection reflects the retailer's strategy of aligning with category-defining brands that have shaped culture and continue to influence consumers worldwide. As a leader in fashion, **REVOLVE** is expanding its portfolio of exclusive partnerships with iconic lifestyle brands, further cementing its position as the premier destination for sought-after collaborations and limited-edition drops.


The **Porsche Collection by REVOLVE** launches August 24, 2026, exclusively at **[REVOLVE.com](http://revolve.com/)** and at The Grove Los Angeles starting August 27th, where dedicated merchandising and immersive branded experiences will bring the collaboration to life.

**About REVOLVE Group, Inc.** Revolve Group, Inc. (NYSE: RVLV) is the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers. As a trusted premium lifestyle brand and a go-to online source for discovery and inspiration, REVOLVE delivers an engaging customer experience from a vast, yet curated, offering of apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty styles. A dynamic platform connects a deeply engaged community of millions of consumers, thousands of global fashion influencers, and more than 1,600 emerging, established, and owned brands.
